name: Summoning Rune (Barbazu Devil)
source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace
description: A summoning circle inlaid into the room's floor detects living creatures and summons a violent devil.
disable: DC 18 Perception check to notice the trap's magic and avoid stepping on the floor outside the circle, followed by DC 21 Thievery check (trained) to break the circle or Dispel Magic (3rd rank; counteract DC 23) to counteract the rune
reset: The trap resets each day at dawn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Summon Devil
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger A living creature steps on any part of the floor not enclosed by the summoning circle

Effect One round after a creature touches the triggering area, the door to the room slams shut and locks (two Thievery checks to pick) and a Barbazu devil appears in the summoning circle.

The devil rolls initiative and remains for 3d6 rounds, after which the spell ends and the devil disappears. The devil also disappears if someone disables the trap before the duration expires.

The summoned devil can use 3 actions each round and can use reactions, unlike most summoned creatures.
